command:
set -euo pipefail; PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-110 bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh flash; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY' | tee /tmp/stage27c-scd41-recovery.log
import serial
import time

port = '/dev/cu.usbserial-110'
deadline = time.monotonic() + 90.0
print(f'SERIAL_CAPTURE_BEGIN port={port} seconds=90', flush=True)
with serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=1.0) as ser:
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        raw = ser.readline()
        if raw:
            line = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').rstrip()
            if 'climate_stage27' in line or 'scd41' in line or 'NimBLE' in line:
                print(line, flush=True)
print('SERIAL_CAPTURE_END', flush=True)
PY
grep -q 'I2C probe: scd41_0x62=ESP_OK ds3231_0x68=ESP_OK' /tmp/stage27c-scd41-recovery.log
grep -q 'Stage27 real-input runtime: i2c=1 scd41=1 ds3231=1 ble=1 outputs=fake-locked' /tmp/stage27c-scd41-recovery.log
grep -q 'scd41_sample=1' /tmp/stage27c-scd41-recovery.log
grep -q 'rtc_available=1 rtc_trusted=1' /tmp/stage27c-scd41-recovery.log
grep -Eq 'ble_last_valid_ms=[1-9][0-9]*' /tmp/stage27c-scd41-recovery.log
